problems.name: low-resource machine translation
problems.passage: We study low-resource machine translation for Swahili and Yoruba.

methods.name: Transformer
methods.passage: The Transformer baseline is trained from scratch on the available parallel data.

methods.name: mBART
methods.passage: mBART is fine-tuned on the same parallel data for each language.

datasets.name: FLORES-200
datasets.passage: We compare a Transformer baseline with mBART fine-tuning on the FLORES-200 dataset.
